headline: DBS Group Reports 5% Decline in Third Quarter Profit
summary: DBS Group reported a 5% decline in third-quarter net profit to $2.8 billion. Additionally, Chairman Peter Seah announced he will retire effective January 1, 2027.
why: DBS is a major financial institution in Asia; its earnings and leadership changes are closely watched by regional banking investors.

impacts.name: DBS Group
impacts.why: A decline in net profit is typically a negative signal for bank stock performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The profit decline, combined with the announcement of a leadership transition, can create uncertainty and downward pressure on the stock.
